decision.observation: 5 mph, gear 1, timer 44:33.770. The D beat put the car back on the gravel, roughly centred with the nose up-frame. Ahead the track runs straight for ~15 m then bends gently left past a white two-storey house, with a white rail fence, Oil banners, cows and a red barn on the right.
decision.hypothesis: Centred on a visibly straight stretch at only 5 mph, one second of plain W should build speed without drifting off; the left bend past the white house is still far enough that no steering is needed yet.
decision.memory: New landmark sequence after the lake: white two-storey house on the left, then white rail fence with Oil banners, cows and a red barn on the right — a pastoral climb. The quick D rejoin from the left grass cost only 7 -> 5 mph.
